decision_defaults.merge: Existing authorization permits nonvisual work after required gates; new designs stay in review.
decision_defaults.priority: Accounting evidence first unless owner steers otherwise.

jobs.title: Refresh reader routes and accepted status
jobs.acceptance: Validated routes to accepted sources, downloads and explicit evidence limits.

jobs.title: Recover and review Foundry invoice packet
jobs.acceptance: Exact source extraction, balanced movements/journals, MD/PDF/XLSX and every page/sheet reviewed; retain draft until owner accepts exact files.

jobs.title: Reconcile every indexed document counterpart
jobs.acceptance: Inventory every existing format-review row. Give explicit manifest or release-member evidence for verified counterparts; retain unresolved dispositions. Do not generate bulk PDFs.

jobs.title: Inventory seven-unit accounting evidence families
jobs.acceptance: Pinned release inventory by scenario/unit/table: customer, receipt, credit, contract/deferred revenue, payable, Treasury, close and consolidation; identify actual human artifacts and native record joins.

jobs.title: Close source-backed subject directory gaps
jobs.acceptance: One source-linked route for every accepted business/department and explicit historical/external subject disposition. Reuse original artwork; never invent separate logos or departments.

jobs.title: Extend customer and deferred-revenue evidence
jobs.acceptance: Complete selected contract/invoice population and deferred-revenue rollforward, formula checks, source IDs and independent per-document files; hold new outputs in review.

jobs.title: Prepare payable and Treasury reading package
jobs.acceptance: Inventory requested/funded/unpaid evidence, reconcile periods and cash categories. Prepare source register and missing-record report; new visual output remains gated. No invented bank documents.

jobs.title: Prepare close and consolidation reading package
jobs.acceptance: Reconcile one pinned full month and scenario from business units to legal entities and eliminations; complete population, no manual balancing adjustments. New workbook requires review.

jobs.title: Index transaction instruments and throughput evidence
jobs.acceptance: Distinguish actual repository instruments, released schedules and absent support. Link consideration/approvals/quantities to existing records; no synthetic signatures or invented legal terms.

jobs.title: Integrate and validate completed batches
jobs.acceptance: Main agent exclusively regenerates shared catalog/links, runs appropriate checks and reviews changed surfaces. Accept independent finished batches; never mark blocked batches complete.
